islands_film_dialog_close_the_film: Accessible name of the icon button that closes the film dialog.
islands_film_dialog_play_the_film: Label of the hero button that opens the product film dialog (FilmDialog); the film's length is shown next to it.
islands_film_dialog_rotate_hint: Hint in the film dialog on a portrait phone that cannot hand the video to native fullscreen.
islands_film_dialog_with_sound: Small note under the 'Play the film' hero button: the film plays with audio.
islands_film_duration: Spoken length of the film for screen readers, such as '1 minute 18 seconds', '2 minutes' or '59 seconds'. {minutes} and {seconds} are whole numbers; a part that is zero is left out.
islands_film_label: Accessible name of the film dialog, the player and its video. {duration} is the spoken length, for example '1 minute 18 seconds'.
islands_film_player_back_5_seconds: Accessible name and menu item of the button that jumps 5 seconds back.
islands_film_player_captions: Accessible name and menu item that turns the captions on or off.
islands_film_player_captions_off: Screen reader announcement after the captions were turned off.
islands_film_player_captions_on: Screen reader announcement after the captions were turned on.
islands_film_player_cc: Short text of the captions button (closed captions).
islands_film_player_chapters: Accessible name of the button, heading and list of the film's chapters.
islands_film_player_close_chapters: Accessible name of the buttons that close the chapters sheet on a phone.
islands_film_player_close_controls: Accessible name of the buttons that close the extra controls sheet on a narrow screen.
islands_film_player_controls: Heading of the sheet with the extra controls on a narrow screen.
islands_film_player_end_install: Text of the end card: install from the terminal in one command or use the installer.
islands_film_player_end_title: Heading of the end card shown when the film finishes.
islands_film_player_english: Label of the captions track of the film (the captions are in English).
islands_film_player_exit_full_screen: Accessible name of the same button while the player is full screen.
islands_film_player_forward_5_seconds: Accessible name and menu item of the button that jumps 5 seconds forward.
islands_film_player_full_screen: Accessible name of the button that makes the player full screen.
islands_film_player_install_atlas: Link on the end card that goes to the install section of the home page.
islands_film_player_more_controls: Accessible name of the button and menu that hold the extra controls on a narrow screen.
islands_film_player_mute: Accessible name and menu item that turns the sound off.
islands_film_player_muted: Screen reader announcement after the sound was turned off.
islands_film_player_pause: Accessible name of the play/pause button while the film is playing.
islands_film_player_paused: Screen reader announcement when the film is paused.
islands_film_player_picture_in_picture: Accessible name and menu item that opens the film in a floating picture-in-picture window.
islands_film_player_play: Play: label of the big start button on the poster and accessible name of the play button in the controls.
islands_film_player_play_label: Accessible name of the big start button on the poster. {duration} is the spoken length of the film.
islands_film_player_playback_blocked: Screen reader announcement when the browser refuses to start the video.
islands_film_player_playback_speed: Accessible name of the speed button; {rate} is the current multiplier.
islands_film_player_playing: Screen reader announcement when the film starts playing.
islands_film_player_rate_x: Playback speed as shown on the speed button and in the speed list, for example 1.5x. {rate} is the multiplier.
islands_film_player_seek: Accessible name of the progress slider: moves the playhead.
islands_film_player_seek_percent: Screen reader announcement after pressing a number key: the film jumped to {percent} percent of its length.
islands_film_player_skipped_back: Screen reader announcement after jumping back. {time} is the new position, such as 0:27.
islands_film_player_skipped_forward: Screen reader announcement after jumping forward. {time} is the new position, such as 0:27.
islands_film_player_sound_on: Screen reader announcement after the sound was turned on.
islands_film_player_speed: Accessible name of the list of playback speeds.
islands_film_player_speed_rate: Speed option in the phone controls menu and the screen reader announcement after choosing a speed. {rate} is the multiplier.
islands_film_player_turn_phone: Notice over the video on a portrait phone: the film is wide and fills the screen only in landscape.
islands_film_player_unmute: Accessible name and menu item that turns the sound back on.
islands_film_player_video_controls: Accessible name of the player's control bar (a toolbar).
islands_film_player_volume: Accessible name of the volume slider.
islands_film_player_watch_again: Button on the end card that restarts the film.
islands_install_copy_copied: Visible text of the same button for two seconds after the command was copied.
islands_install_copy_copy: Visible text of the copy button next to an install command (lowercase on purpose, it sits inside the command box). i18n-distinct: lowercase text of this one button, the shared Copy is a capitalized menu or button label.
islands_install_copy_label: Default accessible name of the copy button next to an install command.
islands_install_copy_powershell_label: Accessible name of the copy button when the command is the PowerShell installer.
islands_install_copy_status_copied: Screen reader announcement after the install command was copied.
islands_share_link_copy_link: Button that copies the download link to the clipboard.
islands_share_link_done: Rest of the confirmation after asking for the download link by email.
islands_share_link_got_it: Bold start of the confirmation after the email form was sent, followed by 'We will email you the download link...'.
islands_share_link_link_copied: Confirmation on the copy button and for screen readers after the download link was copied.
islands_share_link_or_email: Line above the email form on the download page: an alternative to sharing or copying the link.
islands_share_link_send_me_the_link: Submit button of the form that emails the download link.
islands_share_link_share_text: Text of the system share sheet when the visitor shares the download page.
islands_share_link_share_the_link: Button on the download page (phones) that opens the system share sheet with the download link.
islands_stack_visualizer_after: Dependency line of a service node. {service} is the service it waits for; {condition} is the depends_on condition with spaces, such as healthy or completed successfully. i18n-allow glossary:service
islands_stack_visualizer_docker_compose_: Subtitle of the infra node: Atlas runs docker compose up and waits until it is ready.
islands_stack_visualizer_editor_hint: Hint in the header of the atlas.yaml example on the home page; depends_on is the config key.
islands_stack_visualizer_editor_label: Accessible name of the editable atlas.yaml text area.
islands_stack_visualizer_no_port: Subtitle of a service node that declares no port.
islands_stack_visualizer_runs_once: Subtitle of a oneshot service node (a migration): it runs once and must exit with code 0.
islands_stack_visualizer_start_order_blo: Caption above the start-order graph when the edited atlas.yaml has an error.
islands_stack_visualizer_start_order_wav: Caption above the start-order graph: how many waves (groups of services that start together) the edited atlas.yaml has.
islands_stack_visualizer_unknown_depende: Error shown instead of the graph when a depends_on names a service that is not in the file. {service} and {dependency} are service names.
islands_terminal_replay_label: Accessible name of the animated terminal on the home page (the animation itself is hidden from screen readers).
islands_waitlist_done: Rest of the default confirmation after signing up for release notes.
islands_waitlist_email: Visually hidden label of the email field of the release-notes and notify forms.
islands_waitlist_email_placeholder: Example address shown inside the empty email field.
islands_waitlist_error: Error under the form for any other server answer (the request reached the server).
islands_waitlist_get_release_notes: Default submit button of the release-notes signup form.
islands_waitlist_invalid_email: Error under the form when the server rejects the address.
islands_waitlist_notify_me: Submit button of the form for a platform that is not available yet (Intel Mac, Windows on Arm, Linux on Arm) on the download page.
islands_waitlist_platform_done: Rest of the confirmation for a platform that is not available yet. {platform} is its name, for example Windows on Arm.
islands_waitlist_rate_limited: Error under the form when the server limits the number of requests.
islands_waitlist_sending: Text of the submit button while the signup request is in flight.
islands_waitlist_unreachable: Error under the form when the request fails (offline).
islands_waitlist_we_will_tell_you: Bold start of the confirmation after asking to be notified about a platform.
islands_waitlist_you_are_on_the_list: Bold start of the default confirmation after signing up for release notes.
